item.title: Version 1.6.2
item.description:
• **Sharpens the diagnostics for the phantom blue language capsule.** The first captures from 1.6.1 showed ClaudeBar never taking keyboard focus, so the trail now records what actually surrounds a layout change: which app is frontmost when the input source switches, every app switch macOS makes, and each usage probe ClaudeBar runs — all on one timeline in Console (subsystem "one.beatbox.claudeUsageBar").
  • No behaviour changes; this build only adds logging.

item.title: Version 1.6.1
item.description:
• **Fixes a cause of the phantom blue language capsule popping up while you type in other apps.** Opening the popover while a fullscreen app was active made the invisible popover grab keyboard focus (it could not join the fullscreen Space): keys briefly went dead and macOS flashed the input-source badge with no visible cause. The popover now appears properly over fullscreen apps and never holds focus off-screen.
  • Adds a focus diagnostic trail to Console (subsystem "one.beatbox.claudeUsageBar", category "focus"): key-window changes, app activations, and every system input-source switch are logged in release builds, so any remaining capsule sighting can be traced to its exact trigger.

item.title: Version 1.6.0
item.description:
• **Per-model weekly usage now shows every model your plan reports — including Fable.** The popover and menu previously knew only Opus and Sonnet; rows for any other model were silently dropped. Each per-model line from Claude Code now becomes its own row, named and ordered exactly as the CLI reports it — so a newly added model shows up on the next refresh, with no app update needed.
  • Plans without a given model bucket are unchanged: no data means no row, same as before.

item.title: Version 1.5.8
item.description:
• **Background update checks no longer steal focus or flash the input-source capsule while you type** — ClaudeBar now drives Sparkle directly instead of a plugin that periodically activated the app in the background; found updates now surface as an "Update Available (x.y.z)…" item in the menu instead of popping a window.
  • The plan badge (MAX / TEAM / …) now updates when you switch Claude Code accounts — it follows on the next refresh, no restart needed.

item.title: Version 1.5.7
item.description:
• **Fixes ClaudeBar hanging at launch with no menu-bar icon** — a Flutter engine change had merged the platform and UI threads, which could deadlock the menu-bar setup on startup so the app never appeared (and couldn't be reopened). ClaudeBar now opts out of that mode and launches reliably.
  • Lost the menu-bar icon after sleep/wake? Just open ClaudeBar again from Applications or Spotlight and the icon comes right back — no force-quit needed.
  • Clearer guidance when the Claude Code CLI is missing or broken: ClaudeBar now says "Claude Code not found" and tells you to install it, instead of a misleading "update the app" message.

item.title: Version 1.5.6
item.description: • Fix the menu-bar icon being moved into a menu-bar manager's hidden section (Ice, Bartender) after unlocking or waking — the icon now keeps its place

item.title: Version 1.5.5
item.description: • Add an opt-in beta update channel (Settings → "Receive beta updates")

item.title: Version 1.5.4
item.description:
• Fix the menu-bar icon failing to appear at launch (regression in 1.5.3)
  • Menu-bar icon recovers across sleep / wake / screen unlock
  • Stop the blinking text caret stealing keyboard focus at launch

item.title: Version 1.5.3
item.description:
• Fix menu-bar icon disappearing after sleep / wake / screen unlock
  • Fix blinking text caret stealing keyboard focus at launch

item.title: Version 1.5.2
item.description: • ClaudeBar can now update itself — a new "Check for Updates…" item in the menu, plus automatic daily background checks.
